I am Viacheslav Bogdanov, an architect and full-stack engineer.

My work is usually at the intersection of product engineering, developer
tooling, automation, and reliability. I care about systems that are fast enough
to stay enabled, simple enough to maintain, and observable enough to trust.

This blog is written in English and focuses on practical engineering notes:
what was built, why the trade-off was chosen, how it was measured, and what
still needs improvement.
